question: My lantern was delivered on November 20. What is the last day I can return it?
query: lantern return policy return window deadline days from delivery date, eligibility for returns of delivered merchandise
answer: The last day is January 31 (of the following year). Orders delivered between November 1 and December 24 get the holiday extension [3], and the returns policy's worked example confirms this [2].

[1] warranty.md > Relationship to the returns policy
## Safety notices

If a defect is found that affects safety, the company notifies registered owners directly,
publishes a notice on the website and offers a free repair or replacement regardless of warranty
status. The last such notice was in February 2021 for a batch of Beacon 400 battery springs; it
is closed.

## Relationship to the returns policy

The returns policy covers a change of mind within 40 days of delivery for an unused item. The
warranty covers a defect at any time within the warranty period, used or not. A fueled lantern
cannot be returned but can always be claimed under warranty. Agents should route a customer with
a working product who does not want it to the returns policy, and a customer with a product that
does not work to this document.

[2] returns-policy.md > What can be returned
### Worked examples

Order LS-2026-004871 shipped on June 2, 2026 and was delivered on June 5, 2026. Day one is June 6.
The last day to start a return is July 15, 2026.

Order LS-2026-011302 was delivered on November 14, 2026. Under the ordinary rule the window
would close on December 24, 2026. Because the order was delivered between November 1 and
December 24, the holiday extension applies and the customer has until January 31, 2027.

Order LS-2026-009140 was picked up curbside at Frederick on September 9, 2026. The last day to
start a return is October 19, 2026.

## What can be returned

An item is eligible for return when all of the following are true:

- It is unused. A lantern that has been switched on to check that it works is still unused. A
  lantern that has been taken on a trip is not.
- It is in its original packaging with all accessories, inserts, manuals and the warranty card.
- It was purchased from Lantern Supply Co. directly: the online store, by phone, or at the
  Frederick or Annapolis showroom. Items bought from another retailer go back to that retailer.
- It is not on the final-sale list below.

### Fuel put in means no return

Any fuel lantern or oil lamp that has had fuel put in it cannot be returned for a refund or an
exchange, regardless of how little fuel was used or whether it was lit. This covers the Northstar
Dual-Fuel (LS-ND2), the Hagerstown Kerosene Lantern (LS-HK12) and the Heritage No. 7 (LS-H7).
Once fuel has been in the tank or font the item is a hazardous-materials shipment and the
warehouse cannot restock it. A fueled lantern with a defect is handled under the warranty policy,
not the returns policy. Agents should ask directly whether fuel has been put in before issuing an
RA number for any of these three models.

[3] customer-service-playbook.md > Returns
## Looking up an order

Every order has a number in the form LS-2026-xxxxxx: the letters LS, the year the order was
placed, and six digits. An example is LS-2026-004871. Customers find it in the confirmation email
and on the packing slip. Look orders up in the Hearth admin by number, by email address or by the
last four digits of the card.

If the customer does not have the number, ask for the email on the order and the approximate
date. Since Hearth 4.1 a customer can also look up their own order on the online store without an
account using the order number and the postal code on the shipping address.

Never read a full card number, a full address or the contents of an order to anyone who cannot
give you the order number or the email it was placed with.

## Returns

The return window is 40 days from the delivery date recorded by the carrier. It is not counted
from the order date and, since Hearth 4.1 on May 19, 2026, not from the ship date. Check the
delivery scan in the Hearth admin before you tell a customer whether they are inside the window.
Orders delivered between November 1 and December 24 may be returned until January 31.

Returned items must be unused, in the original packaging, with all accessories. Any fuel lantern
or oil lamp that has had fuel in it cannot be returned; those go to warranty if there is a defect.
Clearance items marked "Last Light", custom-engraved items, gift cards, opened fuel, mantles,
wicks and other consumables are final sale.

### Issuing an RA number

Every mailed return needs a return authorization number in the form RA-xxxxxx (six digits), for
example RA-118204. Customers get one themselves through Start a return on the online store, which
has issued RA numbers automatically since Hearth 4.1. On the phone, open the order in the Hearth
admin, choose Create return, pick the items and the reason, and read the RA number back to the
customer. Also email it. A return that arrives at Hagerstown without an RA number waits in the
"no RA" bin until someone matches it, which adds days to the refund, so always issue one.

In-store returns at either showroom do not need an RA number, only the packing slip or the order
number.

[4] returns-policy.md > The return window
## Purpose

This document is the returns policy of Lantern Supply Co. as it applies to orders placed on the
online store, by phone, and in either showroom. Customer service agents, showroom staff and the
Hagerstown warehouse follow it as written. The customer-facing summary on lanternsupply.example
is derived from this document and must not promise more than it does. Questions about an
exception go to the shift lead first, then to Tomas Reyes.

## The return window

A customer may return an eligible item within 40 days of the delivery date. The window is counted
from the date the carrier recorded delivery, not from the date the order was placed and not from
the date it shipped. For showroom purchases, the delivery date is the purchase date on the
receipt. For curbside pickup orders, it is the date the order was handed over at the Frederick
showroom.

Day one is the day after delivery. A return is on time if the customer starts it (requests an RA
number online or by phone, or brings the item to a showroom) on or before day 40. The item itself
may arrive at the warehouse after day 40 as long as the RA number was issued on time and the
package is postmarked within 7 days of the RA number being issued.

### How the window is counted

Since Hearth 4.1, released May 19, 2026, the online store counts the 40 days from the delivery
date as recorded by the carrier. Before 4.1 the store counted the window from the ship date, which
cost customers two to six days and produced a steady stream of complaints about packages that
spent a week in transit. Orders placed before May 19, 2026 that are still open for any reason
are handled under the delivery-date rule as well; agents do not need to look up which rule was in
force.

[5] release-notes.md > Highlights
## 4.1 — May 19, 2026

### Highlights

Start a return online. A customer can begin a return from the order page, choose the items and
the reason, and get a return authorization number (RA-, six digits) at once instead of calling.
The prepaid return label at $8.50 is offered as an option and the amount is shown as a deduction
from the refund before the customer confirms.

The return window is now counted from the delivery date instead of the ship date. The window is
still 40 days, but the clock starts when the carrier records delivery, not when the box leaves
Hagerstown. This came out of the winter returns review: a box that sat with the carrier for
nine days was costing the customer nine days of their window. Orders shipped before May 19 had
their windows recalculated from the delivery date too.

Order lookup without an account. The order number and the email address on the order are enough
to see the status, tracking and the return option.

### Changes

- Start a return online; RA numbers issued automatically and emailed with the instructions.
- Return window counted from the delivery date (was the ship date).
- Order lookup by order number and email, no account needed.
- Returns on orders delivered to a showroom for pickup can be started online too, for return
  in store.
